coreMemory.english: n. paid work or a particular task
coreMemory.structure: do a good job /du ə ɡʊd dʒɑːb/（做得好）；get a job /ɡɛt ə dʒɑːb/（找到工作）；apply for a job /əplaɪ fɔr ə dʒɑːb/（申请工作）；full-time job /fʊl-taɪm dʒɑːb/（全职工作）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use job with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of job in context；❌ translate job word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “do a good job”

commonErrors.wrong: use job with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus dʒɑːb wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of job in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv dʒɑːb ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “do a good job”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /lɝn ðə kəmplit freɪz du ə ɡʊd dʒɑːb/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。
